analyst_view.overall: Early view: Utrecht are 14th under new coach Anthony Correia, who replaced the retired Ron Jans in the summer, and their defence has leaked 31 goals in 11 league games, though they had been unbeaten in three at home before the NEC game. Fortuna Sittard under Danny Buijs are hard to beat, draw a lot and keep the least possession in the league. Utrecht's injury list (Jensen, Engwanda, Paredes, Jonathans, Ohio) should be shorter by December, and this view will be refreshed with team news.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Utrecht's games have been high-scoring because of their leaky defence, but Sittard's run of draws and their deep, low-possession style pull the other way, so I stay with the numbers. Artem Stepanov and Angel Alarcon carry most of Utrecht's scoring.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. I lean higher: Sittard have the lowest average possession in the league and sit back, while Utrecht attack down the flanks through Alarcon, Cathline and Broholm. That should push Utrecht's corner count up.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. No referee has been named yet and neither side has a suspension story, so nothing points away from the numbers for now.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.2 shots. Utrecht should have most of the ball against a Sittard side that defends deep, but Sittard create little themselves, so the two effects roughly cancel out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. With Stepanov back from injury Utrecht have their top scorer, but Sittard's compact defending tends to force shots from range, so I stay with the numbers.
